_why: `STAMP:` exists because seven live cycles emitted `AUDITCYCLE:` while their stamps were never written -- the two-round cap counted stamps and had none, and H3's `legs_changed` refusal could not fire. The token built to catch that decided with `is_file()`, which answers 'a stamp is there', not 'this run wrote one'. `_collected_path` is a pure function of feature/phase/cycle/index, so a re-run of the same cycle reads the PREVIOUS run's stamp: reproduced with a planted stale file, the run printed WRITTEN n=1 while the content stayed byte-identical and still named the earlier run. The mutations attack both directions -- back to existence, and over-corrected so nothing is ever WRITTEN -- because a guard that always cries ABSENT passes the stale-stamp test while making the token useless.

mutations.name: the-check-goes-back-to-mere-existence
mutations._mechanism: The defect restored. A re-run whose gate passed without stamping reports WRITTEN over the previous run's file, so the one instrument that can see the seven-live-cycles failure certifies it instead -- and every downstream consumer (`--round-cap`, `--exit-check`) reads a stamp count it did not earn.
mutations.find:
absent = [r.index for r in scored
                          if not stamped_now.get(r.index, False)]
mutations.replace:
from h_mad_audit_gate import stamp_path as _sp2
                absent = [r.index for r in scored
                          if not _sp2(r.collected_path).is_file()]

mutations.name: no-run-ever-counts-as-having-stamped
mutations._mechanism: The over-correction, and the reason the stale-stamp test alone is not enough. Record every leg as unstamped and the token is permanently ABSENT: it stops distinguishing anything, an operator learns to ignore it, and the real bookkeeping failure it was built for becomes invisible again -- this time behind an alarm that is always on rather than one that never fires.

mutations.name: the-signature-ignores-the-clock
mutations._mechanism: Keep the shape but compare only size. A re-stamp of a cycle whose verdict and leg set are unchanged writes the SAME number of bytes, so an identical-size rewrite reads as no write at all and a correctly stamped re-run reports ABSENT. Scored separately because it is the signature's contract, not the call site's, and a size-only tuple looks entirely reasonable in review.
